description: On this channel, our focus is often on what data can tell us about the War in Ukraine or other conflicts. But data driven insights have to be constantly tested against the experiences of those that have fought a war or been closer to it. Normally that process happens off camera between episodes but today I'm joined by Ukrainian veteran Dmytro Putiata and USMC veteran Rob Lee for a discussion both of the Ukrainian Battlefield in 2026 and (in a follow up) what both sides are trying to do to try and restore manoeuvre on a battlefield where movement can be lethal. Reading and Sourcing
chapters: What Does the Frontline Look Like?
